title: Tinderwick House - Embers Banked Low (SNES register)
_note: The start-town interior cue: the melancholy 6/8 lullaby sibling, re-voiced into the lush SNES register for the game's first indoor moment. Same tune/identity as the gbc version (lead + breathing bass unchanged) but opened up: a warm low STRINGS pad carrying the real chords, the rolling arp re-voiced as a PLUCK music-box, and a single cosy BELL glint per phrase end. snes era => warm reverb 0.18 (the small room) + chord stacking. 80 BPM, 6/8, A minor leaning to relative C major at the very last bar. 16 bars 6/8.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: UNCHANGED. Contracted Vesper: the lift reaches E3->A3->B3 then sighs back; settle sags. Final bar lifts toward C (relative major) and E (V of Am) to lead back.

tracks.name: pad
tracks._note: NEW (SNES). Warm sustained string bed (one chord per bar, dotted-half) - the hearth glow the chip implied. Am-Am-F-Em-Am-G-Am-Em-F-Em-Dm-Am-Am-F-C, last bar C->Em turnaround to lead back to Am.

tracks.name: harmony
tracks._note: Re-voiced from gbc pulse12 to a PLUCK music-box (same rolling 6/8 arpeggio notes). Am, G, F, Em, C under the final relative-major turn.
